Definition: of Latin origin; probably pertaining to the river Tiberis or Tiber; Tiberius, a Roman emperor:--Tiberius.
BiblicalUsage: Tiberius is Tiberius Caesar, the Roman emperor in whose reign John the Baptist began to preach and Jesus was crucified. In Luke 3:1, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Tiberius shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
